metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __SQDS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('dim_currency'[currency_code])),
			AND(
				AND(
					'dim_currency'[currency_code] IN {"VND"},
					'dim_currency'[currency_code] IN {"VND"}
				),
				'dim_currency'[currency_code] IN {"VND"}
			)
		)

	VAR __SQDS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS(
			{"2025-01",
				"2025-02",
				"2025-03",
				"2025-04",
				"2025-05",
				"2025-06",
				"2025-07",
				"2025-08",
				"2025-09",
				"2025-10",
				"2025-11",
				"2025-12"},
			'dim_date'[year_month]
		)

	VAR __SQDS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'dim_geography'[province_name],
			__SQDS0FilterTable,
			__SQDS0FilterTable2,
			"Sumaward_amount_sum", CALCULATE(SUM('fact_award_daily'[award_amount_sum]))
		)

	VAR __SQDS0BodyLimited = 
		TOPN(10, __SQDS0Core, [Sumaward_amount_sum], 0, 'dim_geography'[province_name], 1)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('dim_currency'[currency_code])),
			AND(
				'dim_currency'[currency_code] IN {"VND"},
				'dim_currency'[currency_code] IN {"VND"}
			)
		)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS(
			{"2025-01",
				"2025-02",
				"2025-03",
				"2025-04",
				"2025-05",
				"2025-06",
				"2025-07",
				"2025-08",
				"2025-09",
				"2025-10",
				"2025-11",
				"2025-12"},
			'dim_date'[year_month]
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('dim_geography'[province_name], "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"),
			__SQDS0BodyLimited,
			__DS0FilterTable,
			__DS0FilterTable2,
			"Trúng_thầu___tỷ_VND", '_Measures'[Trúng thầu · tỷ VND]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			502,
			__DS0Core,
			[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			0,
			[Trúng_thầu___tỷ_VND],
			0,
			'dim_geography'[province_name],
			1
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC,
	[Trúng_thầu___tỷ_VND] DESC,
	'dim_geography'[province_name]

				'fact_supplier_daily'[recipient_allocation_state] IN {"single_recipient"}
			)
		)

	VAR __SQDS0FilterTable3 = 
		TREATAS({"ORGANIZATION",

			"PERSON"}, 'dim_party'[party_kind])

		)

	VAR __SQDS0BodyLimited = 
		TOPN(10, __SQDS0Core, [Sumaward_amount_sum], 0, 'dim_party'[party_display], 1)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('dim_currency'[currency_code])),
			AND(
				'dim_currency'[currency_code] IN {"VND"},
				'dim_currency'[currency_code] IN {"VND"}
			)
		)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS({"single_recipient"}, 'fact_supplier_daily'[recipient_allocation_state])

		)

	__DS0PrimaryWindowed
